Name: GHXYK2 Classics Vol. 1
Overview:
GHXYK2 Classics Vol. 1 is a collection of surrealist art pieces disguised as games. It contains:

Maek Like Bike: A side-scrolling adventure where the player controls a bicycle on a mission to catch the Apollo 13 rocket launch. The environment is extremely surreal, constantly flashing with random words and images. After catching up with the rocket, the bike is taken into space, where it must locate a black hole. The black hole then turns the bike into a shaver which is then used to shave a man's head.

Random Cartoon Generator: A animation of two pointy-eared creatures who head into town after being dissatisfied with what's on TV. The dialogue spoken by the characters and locations visited is randomized each time.

My Humps My Dumps: A side-scrolling infinite runner game where the player controls a camel running through a desert. Points awarded are based on time spent alive, with more points awarded the closer to the moon the camel jumps. Colliding with a dune ends the game. The player's high score is recorded.
